system.description:
Six-fingered prince of pleasure and betrayal. His court is built entirely on seduction.

  • Dark Gift (1st): Once per day, after failing a Charisma check, reroll and take either result. Advantage on Cha checks against creatures that find you appealing. A creature that fails a save against one of your enchantment spells has Disadvantage on attack rolls against you until the end of your next turn.
  • Patron's Mark (6th): Once per day, reroll any failed Charisma-based check and take the higher result. Additionally you always know instinctively what a creature finds most attractive or desirable about you.
  • Patron Feature (12th): Once per day, cast a heightened Charm Monster — target has disadvantage on the save, and on failure believes you are their closest friend for the duration.
